# Redaction record for the public copy

This folder was copied from the programme's record on 2026-10-27 and redacted by one deterministic script before publication. The script applied the ordered substitutions below to every text file except Lean sources (no Lean source needed a change, except the two withheld below). Nothing else in the content was changed by it. The gate `tool/ledger.py` was added afterwards, unchanged.

| rule | replaced by | substitutions |
|---|---|---|
| name of the private Elenchus repository | `[private Elenchus repository]` | 26 |
| URL of the private LeanFlow repository | `[private LeanFlow repository]` | 2 |
| the user's home directory | `<home>` | 153 |
| absolute path of the producing repository checkout | `<producer-repo>` | 1173 |
| mount path of the data disk | `<data-disk>` | 68 |
| file names of third-party paper text extractions (not redistributed) | `third_party_extract_<n>.txt` | 8 |
| paths of agent session/tool-output files | `<agent-session-file>` | 10 |
| mount path of the data disk (user folder) | `<data-disk>` | 68 |
| absolute path of the producing repository | `<producer-repo>` | 16 |
| Clay Institute problem-page URLs quoted from upstream | `https://www.claymath.org/` | 2 |
| upstream wording naming the Clay prize problems | `Clay prize problem` | 1 |
| a keyword naming the Clay problems | `Clay problem` | 1 |
| file-name suffix of third-party full texts (not redistributed) | `_text.txt` | 3 |
| module path of the five hidden theorems | `Acronymes.lean` | 3 |

## Withheld files

These files are listed in their `lean_manifest.json` with `copied_to: null` and the reason below. `tools/check_consistency.py` counts them as withheld, not as missing.

- `discoveries/p2_navier_stokes_audit/lean/results/proposal2/2026-10-26/A2/evidence/audit/ChallengeDump_NS.lean`: statement dump of the upstream openai/NavierStokesAndEuler challenge file; it embeds producing-machine paths and upstream docstrings; fetch the upstream file at the pinned commit listed in LEAN.md.
- `discoveries/p2_navier_stokes_audit/lean/results/proposal2/2026-10-26/A2/evidence/controls/env/EnvControl.lean`: planted-control file whose text embeds producing-machine paths; the control's verdict is recorded in the ledger evidence.

## Re-hashed evidence blobs

274 evidence blobs changed under the substitutions. Each was renamed to the sha256 of its new bytes, and the old digest was replaced by the new one in every file of its discovery folder (the ledger, its build script, notes). A blob that cites another blob was re-hashed after it, until nothing changed. Digests quoted in the Zenodo records (PDFs, uploaded ledgers) are the old ones; this table maps them.
